deprecatedDetails.title: Deprecated details
deprecatedDetails.description: Information about the deprecation of the field.

deprecatedVersion.title: Version
deprecatedVersion.description: The version in which the field was first deprecated.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the reason for the field's deprecation and information about its replacement, if any.

codelist.title: Codelist
codelist.description: The CSV file that defines the codes in the codelist that the field refers to.

openCodelist.title: Open codelist
openCodelist.description: Whether the codelist that the field refers to is an open codelist.

deprecatedDetails.description: This keyword is deprecated favour of using `enum` to indicate a closed codelist. An field refers to an open codelist when `codelist` is set without the presence of `enum`.

x-references.title: References
x-references.description: Marks a property or $defs entry as a foreign-key reference to an entity elsewhere in the schema.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: The JSON Pointer to the $defs entry for the referenced entity.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: The JSON Pointer to the property holding the array of instances of the referenced entity.

property.title: Property
property.description: The name of the property, on the referenced entity, that this reference's value is matched against.

from.title: From
from.description: The name of the property, on the object where x-references is declared, whose value provides the reference. Used when x-references is declared on a $defs entry (e.g. OrganisationReference) rather than directly on the referencing property.

x-logical-type.title: Logical type
x-logical-type.description: Marks how a $defs entry or property is treated when the schema's logical data model is extracted.

x-relationship-label.title: Relationship label
x-relationship-label.description: A human-friendly label describing the relationship represented by a property, used when documenting or diagramming the data model.
